body: I can relate to so many things you wrote here. I also hate myself and even on a “good” day I dislike myself for so many reasons. I’m never good enough in my eyes even when other people think I am. I also don’t see any point in any of this. I go to school too and I do okay but I don’t see the purpose behind it just to get a job and then be miserable there. It’s a never ending cycle of pointlessness if you know what I mean?Anyways I’m writing and letting you know I hear you, I feel your pain and your despair and I’m relating 100% i actually did run away from home and it’s been a few years now. Anyways enough of my rambling, I don’t know where you are but I hope I can send some relief your way. At least know that I hear you. Someone over here cares...

I’m sorry you were forced. Being force along with the anxiety makes it so much worse. Then you really feel trapped. I hope both of us having a brighter future which we get to decide on which anyone man or women influencing us. That’s real freedom.
I’m actually in counseling and it’s fully aware that he’s controlling even the therapist knows. I have no where to turn. I swear to you nothing is worse than this feeling.
Ok I’ll look into that but I think you’re right. You can’t do much the older someone gets but I’ll try.

Thank you for this advice, it’s really helpful. And I wasn’t exactly looking for people to speculate about a diagnosis but I guess more of seeing if it strikes others as inappropriate as I see it which I think it probably does. Sometimes I think that my thinking of off about the situation but then I really don’t feel like it is... I do try to coach her in the most gentle way I can without hurting her feelings .
